svg.title: Where the points were
svg.desc: Dev scores on 120 puzzles with 95% confidence intervals. Bare model 12.2. Eyes-only skill r1a 42.9, and 43.4 when run again. The 8 rewrites from rounds 2 to 5 scored 41.0, 33.8, 41.3, 36.2, 35.7, 35.0, 43.5, 40.8. One-rule edits scored 43.1 and 40.2. Adding a calculation tool scored 59.9. Telling the model the first move scored 64.6, so 21.7 points sat above the plateau, and the calculation tool reached 78% of them.
